rq: raw language equivalence and latent intervention partition joint identification
summary: Paired multimodal and partially observed multi-view theorems can identify shared latent information under explicit assumptions, but the shared block is not automatically the raw-language quotient Q, the exact full-consequence target quotient P, or denotation d. Pairing may identify episode, context, speaker, policy, or instance nuisance; may be too coarse; or may encode gold semantics through pair construction.
